brief:
Gaza's health ministry warned Sunday that critical laboratory capabilities are deteriorating sharply, with declining medical testing capacity threatening to disrupt diagnostic work and treatment monitoring for thousands of patients across the territory, Shehab Wire reported.

The ministry did not specify the cause of the laboratory crisis in the available statement, but flagged the cascade effect: as testing infrastructure fails, physicians lose the ability to diagnose conditions and track patient progress across multiple health facilities.

title: Gaza's health ministry warns of collapsing laboratory capacity
